desc: The XT00 switch provides reliable, remote activation for SureFire X-Series Weapon Lights (except the XH50G) attached to any MIL-1913 Picatinny rail. The XT00 features a constant-on/off toggle switch and a lockout toggle switch to prevent accidental operation. The XT00 accepts ST07, SR07, SR07-D-IT, and their longer cable models.
